name: comfyui-output-swap
description: Drag one output onto another to take over its downstream links — reroute a connection's source without hunting for the target input. TypeScript source in src/, built to web/dist/ via bun build. See ADR-0001.

scripts.build: bun build ./src/index.ts --target browser --format esm --banner '/* web/dist bundle built by bun from src/ in this repository (see package.json). No third-party code is bundled. */' --outdir web/dist --external '/scripts/*'
